dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters on a dark background; most prominent structure located mid-body displays a sharp gradient transition from a dark exterior boundary to a high-intensity interior field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of asymmetrical, high-intensity light pixel clusters concentrated on the lateral flank; core pixel concentration is highest in the mid-section patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent 'O' rings form an irregular quadrilateral on the upper lateral flank; relative distances between these points vary significantly with the most dorsal pair showing the closest proximity.

other_distinctive_markers: Deeply recessed transverse fold in the integument located at the base of the caudal flippers.
